nuggets.text: The issue is caused by a field in the orders table named customer, which conflicts with the relationship name in the Order model.
When $order->customer is called, it retrieves the integer value from the customer field instead of the related Customer model.
Rename the customer field in the orders table to customer_id or change the relationship method name in the Order model to avoid the conflict.
After resolving the conflict, access the customer's first name using the new relationship method.
